sites.name: Nasca Lines (lookout tower and natural lookout)
sites.era: ancient (era not stated in the tariff annex)
sites.what: Geoglyphs on the Nasca plain, seen from two ground lookouts or by air.

access.tickets: Lookout tower: S/6 general, S/2 higher-education students, S/1 minors. Natural lookout: S/3 general, S/2 students, S/1 minors. Partial aerial circuit tourist ticket: S/47 for national and foreign tourists (in force since 31 January 2022). 50% off for over-60s, teachers, people with disability and volunteer military. No RBA rate for PEN.
access.permits: Flight operators sell the overflight itself; the S/47 is the circuit ticket.

lore.text: Popular theories claim the lines were landing strips or signals meant for visitors from the sky.
lore.label: popular lore, not an official source

access.tickets: S/7.50 general, S/4 students, S/1 minors; covers monument and museum. No RBA rate for PEN.
